# Remote migration history snapshot

This file records the read-only comparison used to make the checked-in chain
replayable without rewriting the linked project's migration ledger. It is an
operational manifest, not a migration and not a reconstruction of missing SQL.

Snapshot taken on 2026-08-30 with `supabase migration list` against project
`fskrxkiujtfuxntcrjam`:

- remote versions: 223
- exact local/remote version matches: 32
- remote-only versions: 191
- local-only versions after this cleanup: 71
- remote versions before the first formerly checked-in migration: 119

The bodies of the 119 remote prehistory migrations are unavailable in this
repository. `20260823000000_root_schema_baseline.sql` is therefore a narrow,
conditional compatibility baseline for the root objects required by the local
chain. It must not be represented as recovered history. No `migration repair`,
`db push`, or other remote mutation was used.

## Static clean-replay dependency inventory

A scan of every schema-qualified relation, schema, and function reference in
timestamp order found these dependencies before their local creation:

| Dependency | Replay source |
| --- | --- |
| `public.contacts` | conditional compatibility baseline |
| `public.employees` | conditional compatibility baseline |
| `public.leads` | conditional compatibility baseline |
| `public.jobs` | conditional compatibility baseline |
| `public.documents` | conditional compatibility baseline |
| `public.dripjobs_sales_deals` | conditional compatibility baseline |
| `private` schema | conditional compatibility baseline |
| `private.is_manager()` | created only when absent by compatibility baseline |
| `auth.users`, `auth.uid()` | standard Supabase local Auth schema |
| `extensions.digest(text,text)` | standard Supabase local `pgcrypto` extension |
| generated sequences plus index/constraint names | created with their owning local tables or earlier local index declarations |
| `public.sync_ottawa_painters_customers_without_identity_dedupe()` | transitional name created by a local function rename |
| `private.sync_ottawa_painters_customers_without_identity_dedupe()` | the transitional public function is moved into `private`, then explicitly replaced later |

No other unresolved relation, schema, or function dependency was found. The
SQL contract `supabase/tests/schema_root_contract.sql` makes the external-stack
and compatibility-root assumptions executable. A clean `supabase db reset`
remains the required end-to-end proof; if Docker is unavailable, this manifest
is evidence of static coverage only, not proof that the missing historical SQL
has been recovered.

## Remote-only versions

later version drift, largely representing different timestamp identities for
changes whose local source files are present under other version numbers.
